description: Reads a public website: which chat or voice-AI tools it runs, whether an AI disclosure is already shown, and, for the business described, which laws that leaves unmet. The same check as the free scan at botnotice.app/scan, without the browser pass. Not legal advice.

all_us.description: Customers anywhere in the U.S. The default when no place is given.

big_platform.description: 10 million or more unique monthly U.S. visitors.

eu.description: People in the European Union can use the AI.

licensed_profession.description: A state-licensed profession: health, legal, accounting.

memory.description: The bot remembers people or builds rapport (companion-style).

minors.description: Whether minors may use it: no, possible (default), or directed (aimed at them).

states.description: Two-letter U.S. state codes where the customers are, e.g. ["CA","NY"]. Leave out with all_us.

uk.description: People in the United Kingdom can use the AI.

use_cases.description: How the business uses AI. Codes: support_chatbot (Customer-service / FAQ chatbot); sales_chatbot (Sales, lead-capture, or booking chatbot); companion_chatbot (Chatbot with memory, persona, or relationship features); voice_agent (AI phone / voice agent); ai_content (AI-generated marketing text, images, or video); synthetic_performers (AI-generated 'people' in ads); ai_hiring (AI in hiring, screening, or HR decisions); healthcare (AI in patient diagnosis, treatment, or care); mental_health (AI offering emotional support or therapy-like help); advice (AI giving financial, legal, or medical guidance); automated_decisions (AI deciding eligibility (credit, housing, insurance, benefits)). Default: support_chatbot.

name: check_website
title: Check a website for AI chat tools and an AI notice
